description: PAA v2.0 (GS4GG PAA M400-12 V2.0) default fuel emission factors for the baseline emission factor (Eq.1). V2 changed the CHARCOAL factors from V1: combustion-only defaults, or the higher figures that include charcoal production at a mandatory wood-to-charcoal conversion factor (WCCF) — 6:1 for Sub-Saharan Africa and LDCs, 4:1 for other regions. A v2.0 run with charcoal must name which; the engine refuses a charcoal entry on the V1 factors (since 2026-09-21). Wood is unchanged from V1.

6:1.label: WCCF 6:1 — mandatory for Sub-Saharan Africa and LDCs
6:1.cite: V2 SDWS 9 p.51: 'the mandatory WCCF ratios (6:1 for SSA/LDCs; 4:1 for other regions)'

combustion-only.label: Combustion only (no charcoal-production emissions)
combustion-only.cite: V2 SDWS 9 p.51 'Default: 112 tCO2/TJ (combustion only)'; SDWS 10 p.52 'Default: 5.87'

wood.cite: V2 SDWS 9 p.51 (wood 112); SDWS 10 p.52 (wood 9.46, AR5 GWP)

charcoal.cite: V2 SDWS 9 p.51 (charcoal: 112 combustion only; 355.36 WCCF 6:1; 236.91 WCCF 4:1); SDWS 10 p.52 (5.87; 89.68; 61.74)
V1 SDWS 9.2 / 10.2 p.24 — includes production emissions at V1's own ratio; NOT a V2 value
